description: This file contains implementation of functions related to CCSP CWMP session objects, including the creation function CcspCwmpCreateWmpSession. It is part of the CCSP CWMP protocol stack and provides platform-dependent and utility functions for managing CWMP session objects.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CcspCwmpCreateWmpSession(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new CCSP CWMP session object, given container, owner, and reserved context handles.
